messages:
Aisha CSM: Heads-up — Springboard renewal just hit my queue. They asked for a 6mo pricing wedge to match budget timing; also mentioned procurement wants PO not CC. vendor code looks off on the PO they sent. Can we land a small concession?
Marco RevOps: Do we have margin to do a wedge? if it's time-boxed (6mo) maybe offer a one-time onboarding credit instead of %-off. preserves list price.
Jonas Finance: Vendor code mismatch: customer sent PO with vendor 789-ACME-EU but billing entity is 789-ACME. We can't invoice EU vendor on our US entity. Need legal/ops to confirm path. PO preferred by customer but finance needs correct vendorcode.
Leah Legal: We can't change billing entity without exec approval. If they insist on their PO, we can accept it only with a signed amendment that maps the PO to the correct legal entity. Draft will be short.
Aisha CSM: DocuSign attempt failed twice — signer reports "access denied". Also customer asked for confirmation that the credit won't affect their onboarding schedule.
Priya Enablement: We can hold onboarding kickoff a week if needed, but to keep momentum we can offer a 1-hour enablement session credit now and schedule the rest after signature.
Marco RevOps: Proposal: instead of a % wedge, offer $2,000 one-time onboarding credit + 1 immediate enablement hour. That keeps ARR intact and resolves their short-term budget ask. Finance/legal ok?
Jonas Finance: $2k credit is fine if it's one-off and captured in amendment. Need PO number referenced on the amendment and invoice. Also ask customer to confirm vendorcode by EOD.
Leah Legal: I can draft the amendment: scope = one-time $2,000 credit; invoice will reference PO #{PO_NUM}; clause adding vendorcode mapping if needed. Who will own the DocuSign retry?
Aisha CSM: I'll own DocuSign chase and vendorcode confirmation. @Docusign-bot please re-send envelope. Also capturing feedback: procurement friction + vendorcode confusion — important signal for playbook. :memo:
Docusign-bot: DocuSign envelope 0X-707 re-sent to signer <customer.signer@example.com>. Status: sent.
Aisha CSM: Amendment snippet for legal: 
```
Amendment: One-time onboarding credit of $2,000 to be applied to invoice X. Customer PO #{PO_NUM} must be referenced on the invoice. Credit does not change subscription list price or renewal calculations.
```
Priya Enablement: I'll schedule the immediate 1-hr enablement session for next Tue and collect feedback using the short onboarding survey. Will also track whether the credit improves perceived value.
Marco RevOps: I'll log the credit in the renewal record and update ARR calc. Target: get PO + signed amendment by 2026-06-05. If we don't have PO by EOW, flag renewal risk.
Jonas Finance: Noted — if PO arrives after month close, invoicing delays possible. Finance requests a backup of CC authorization in case PO fails.
Aisha CSM: For transparency: risk = medium-high until PO + signature. Captured feedback: procurement tooling + vendorcode mapping. Next steps: Aisha (DocuSign + vendorcode), Leah (draft amendment), Marco (update renewal + credit), Jonas (invoicing path + backup CC), Priya (enablement scheduling + survey). Thanks all :thumbsup:
